# FAMILY02 B — successor-visible case facts

Blank, cell, duplicate, and custody checks pass. Turbidity is 250 NTU. Reproducible composition is 84% mineral grains and 3% organic flocs, matching the measured mineral-dominant pattern. No gravimetric reference is provided.

response.fallback: RECONCILE: record supplied inputs and zero-match reason; retain and apply the M0 pathway.
response.rationale: The organic-floc selector does not match. The preserved M0 pathway applies to the supplied mineral-dominant pattern and yields 1.35 × 250 + 12 = 349.5 mg/L.

reported_values.name: fallback_reason
reported_values.value: Zero selector matches: the mineral-dominant pattern is outside the organic-floc selector.

reported_values.name: M0_pathway_status
reported_values.value: Applicable: valid in-range measurement matching the original mineral-dominant matrix; REPORT_ESTIMATE.

response.scope: Report 349.5 mg/L with the original mineral-matrix calibration band of ±12 mg/L. No case-specific gravimetric verification is available.
